source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 652 restores attendeerole and usertype attributes in the same functions that update Fluent tooltip attributes. CSS selects the sprite from those exact attribute values. Changing only the localized tooltip can leave the wrong visible role or user-type image. Current role and user-type setters still write both states. This establishes DOM/CSS behavior, not an accessible name or keyboard-operability pass. The current icons are img elements with click handlers; focusability, keyboard cycling and screen-reader exposure were not verified.
title: Update attendee sprite state and localized tooltip state together
